title: Todos table schema and migration
description: Define the todos table for project to-do items with completion tracking, urgency, due dates, sort order, and optional grouping under milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to projects.id with cascade delete
is_completed and is_urgent boolean fields present

steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/todos.ts. Define todos table: id (uuid pk defaultRandom), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects.id cascade delete), milestone_id (uuid nullable FK → milestones.id set null on delete), title (varchar 500 notNull), is_completed (boolean notNull default false), is_urgent (boolean notNull default false), due_date (date nullable), sort_order (integer notNull default 0), completed_at (timestamp nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on project_id and composite index on (project_id, is_completed) for efficient progress calculation queries.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type Todo and type NewTodo. Add 'export * from ./todos' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify the todos table has all columns, FK constraints, and the composite index.

technicalNotes: milestone_id uses 'set null' on delete so todos survive milestone deletion
The composite index on (project_id, is_completed) powers the progress calculation query: SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE project_id = x (total) and WHERE is_completed = true (done)
